ValidationRule.description: If the picklist value "Other" is selected for the field "Type of Contract" on the TTS Opportunity page, the "Other Type of Contract" field is required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( RecordType.Name ='TTS OTCRM Opportunity', ISBLANK( Other_Type_of_Contract__c ), ISPICKVAL( Type_of_Contract__c , 'Other') ), AND( RecordType.Name ='TTS OTCRM Opportunity', NOT (ISBLANK( Other_Type_of_Contract__c )), NOT (ISPICKVAL( Type_of_Contract__c , 'Other')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill out " Other Type of Contract" only if "Other" was chosen as Type of Contract field. If you did not choose "Other", leave it blank
